battle.name: 中越戰爭
battle.brief: 中越戰爭於一九七九年二月爆發，中國人民解放軍與越南人民軍在中國與越南邊境地區交戰。人民空軍投入殲-6戰鬥機執行制空、攔截與空域防衛任務；此型機早於本輪衝突列裝，並在交戰期間實際參與邊境空防作戰，是人民空軍作戰體系中承擔攔截任務的早期噴氣式戰鬥機。

kit.name: 殲-6戰鬥機
kit.history: 殲-6是人民空軍早期的主力制空戰鬥機，主要承擔高空攔截與空域防衛任務，並與其他戰鬥機共同構成邊境方向的空中防線。

countries: 中越戰爭的交戰國是中華人民共和國與越南社會主義共和國。1979年2月17日開始的攻勢並非沿一條連續戰線展開：中國在廣西軍區方向由南寧指向諒山、高平及邊境要地，在雲南軍區方向由河口、紅河兩側的老街與西北山地指向萊州方向。中國以軍、集團軍、師及直屬支援部隊分路作戰；越南則以北部的諒山、高平主要作戰區和南部的老街方向互相連通，以河內為縱深，調集步兵師、邊防部隊與預備隊。蘇聯是越南的主要武器供應方，但地面戰的實際交戰者仍是中國與越南軍隊。
countriesEn: The belligerents in the Sino-Vietnamese War were the People's Republic of China and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. The offensive launched on 17 February 1979 did not unfold along one continuous front. In the Guangxi Military Region, Chinese forces advanced from Nanning toward Lạng Sơn, Cao Bằng, and other border strongpoints. In the Yunnan Military Region, they moved from Hekou, from the Lao Cai area and the northwestern highlands on both sides of the Red River, toward the L.ai Châu area. China committed armies, army groups, divisions, and directly attached support units on separate axes. Vietnam connected the principal northern theaters at Lạng Sơn and Cao Bằng with the southern axis around Lào Cai, used Hà Nội as its strategic depth, and committed infantry divisions, border troops, and reserve formations. The Soviet Union was Vietnam's principal supplier of weapons, but the actual ground combatants were the forces of China and Vietnam.
people: 關鍵決策與指揮分屬不同層級。中共中央政治局核心鄧小平主持作出並推動出兵決定，具體作戰由解放軍總參謀部、廣西軍區和雲南軍區組織。廣西方向由徐世友任軍區司令員、楊得志任政委，五十五軍集團系統內的四十一軍等部擔負高平、諒山方向的主要攻擊；雲南方向由熊克武任司令員、張愛萍任政委，十四軍集團統籌，三十九軍等部隊投入紅河與老街方向。越南方面，由總參謀長文進勇統籌全國防務調度，黎仲謙、黃文祿等指揮官參與前線兵力和火力運用，並把四十三步兵師部署於諒山，與北部邊防部隊及後續調來的師、旅共同構成縱深。中越兩軍的指揮差異，在很大程度上表現為中國集中兵員與重火器速攻，越南則強調固定陣地、縱深預備隊和戰術反擊。
peopleEn: The decisive political decisions and operational command operated at different levels. Deng Xiaoping, the central figure of the Politburo, chaired and drove the decision to launch the campaign, while field operations were organized by the PLA General Staff and the Guangxi and Yunnan military regions. In Guangxi, Xu Shiyou was military-region commander and Yang Dezhi was political commissar. Formations under the 55th Army Group, including the 41st Army, carried the principal attacks toward Cao Bằng and Lạng Sơn. In Yunnan, Xiong Kewu was commander and Zhang Aiping was political commissar; the 14th Army Group coordinated operations, with the 39th Army and other formations committed around the Red River and Lào Cai. On the Vietnamese side, Chief of the General Staff Văn Tiến Dũng directed nationwide military movements, while commanders such as Lê Trọng Tấn and Hoàng Văn Lương helped manage frontline troops and fire support. The 43rd Infantry Division was deployed at Lạng Sơn and formed part of a depth structure that also included northern border troops and divisions and brigades brought forward from elsewhere. The contrast between the commands appeared chiefly in Chinese concentration of manpower and heavy firepower for rapid attacks and Vietnamese reliance on fortified positions, operational reserves, and tactical counterattacks.
kits: 裝備上的核心差距是中國的集中火力與越南的防禦工具。中國步兵大量使用56式自動步槍，標準小口徑彈藥為7.62×39毫米，並配備82毫米迫擊炮；炮兵大量使用63式130毫米野戰砲或榴彈砲，坦克支援主要依靠59式坦克，後方還有汽車、拖車、搶修車和通信車。越南步兵常見AK-47自動步槍、PKM通用機槍及RPG-7火箭筒，反坦克和封鎖道路的任務多由步兵、炮兵及工兵協同完成；炮兵使用蘇制D-30 122毫米野戰砲、M-46 130毫米榴彈砲，裝甲力量包括T-54坦克、PT-76兩棲坦克及BTR-50裝甲輸送車。空軍方面，中國可投入J-6戰鬥機和A-5攻擊機，越南則使用MiG-21與Su-7執行攔截或對地攻擊。7.62毫米步槍彈、迫擊炮彈、122與130毫米炮彈均需由後方運至前線。道路狹窄使雙方都必須設立分段前進彈藥庫，以車輛运送燃油，再以軍隊和畜力向山地搬運；因此，任何深入數十公里的部隊都會拉長補給線，坦克也不能脫離工兵整理的道路或橋梁。
kitsEn: The principal equipment contrast was China's concentration of firepower against Vietnam's defensive tools. Chinese infantry extensively used the Type 56 assault rifle firing 7.62×39 mm ammunition and employed 82 mm mortars. Their artillery included large numbers of Type 63 130 mm field guns or howitzers, while armored support centered on Type 59 tanks; trucks, trailers, recovery vehicles, and communications vehicles supported these formations. Vietnamese infantry commonly carried AK-47 assault rifles, PKM general-purpose machine guns, and RPG-7 rocket launchers, with antiarmor and road-blocking tasks conducted jointly by infantry, artillery, and engineers. Vietnamese artillery included Soviet D-30 122 mm field guns and M-46 130 mm howitzers, while armored forces fielded T-54 tanks, PT-76 amphibious tanks, and BTR-50 armored personnel carriers. In the air, China could employ J-6 fighters and A-5 attack aircraft, while Vietnam used MiG-21 and Su-7 fighters for interception or ground attack. Rifle ammunition, mortar bombs, and 122 mm and 130 mm artillery shells all had to be carried forward from the rear. Because the roads were narrow, both sides established supply points in stages, moved fuel by truck, and relied on troops and animal transport to carry supplies into the mountains. Any formation advancing dozens of kilometers lengthened its supply route, and tanks could not leave roads and bridges cleared by engineers.
tactics: 2月17日凌晨，中國各路先以130毫米砲、迫擊炮及部分航空兵力壓制越軍陣地，再由工兵處理路障，步兵以班、排為單位沿山脊、林地和溪谷分進，奪取能觀察射界及控制道路的高地；坦克則在步兵之間沿主要道路推進。北線四十一軍等部在Bô Cô河多處架橋渡河，於2月18日進入並控制高平，後續部隊再向諒山方向展開；南線三十九軍等部則在Manhao及鄰近渡口渡過紅河，以59式坦克和步兵共同向寶獵方向推進。越南沒有始終維持一條平直防線，而是把陣地配置在山脊、路口和城鎮外围，以交叉砲火及反坦克小組封鎖道路；諒山的四十三步兵師利用既有陣地阻止中國部隊繼續越過南部高地。越南預備隊和邊防部隊曾對戰線兩翼實施夜間反擊，老街與寶獵方向也出現反覆爭奪，砲兵則打擊對方集結地、彈藥庫和道路樞紐。到2月下旬，中國攻勢普遍縮短，部队轉為控制已奪高地並保護縱深補給線；越南則一面鞏固諒山等關鍵地區，一面準備在中國撤軍時追擊和收復失地。
tacticsEn: In the early hours of 17 February, Chinese formations opened with 130 mm artillery, mortars, and air support to suppress Vietnamese positions. Engineers then cleared obstacles, while infantry squads and platoons advanced in separated groups along ridges, wooded slopes, and streams to seize high ground that provided observation and controlled roads. Tanks moved along the main routes between the infantry. In the north, the 41st Army and other formations bridged several points across the Bô Cô River, entered and controlled Cao Bằng on 18 February, and then expanded toward Lạng Sơn. In the south, the 39th Army and other units crossed the Red River at Manhao and nearby crossing points, using Type 59 tanks and infantry together as they advanced toward Bảo Lộc. Vietnam did not maintain one straight defensive line throughout. It placed positions on ridges, at road junctions, and around the approaches to towns, using intersecting artillery fire and antiarmor teams to close routes. The 43rd Infantry Division at Lạng Sơn used prepared positions to stop Chinese forces from advancing beyond the southern heights. Vietnamese reserves and border troops conducted nighttime counterattacks against the flanks, while fighting repeatedly shifted around Lào Cai and Bảo Lộc. Artillery struck opposing assembly areas, ammunition depots, and road hubs. By late February, Chinese attacks generally shortened, and their units shifted toward holding captured heights and protecting longitudinal supply routes. Vietnam consolidated positions around Lạng Sơn and other key areas while preparing to pursue and recover lost ground during the Chinese withdrawal.
data: 時間上，邊境射擊在1979年1月已持續發生；北京於2月16日發出最後外交照會，攻勢在2月17日展開，3月5日宣布撤軍，至3月16日全部離開越南境內，因此涵蓋二十八個日曆日。常見兵力資料把中國投入概括為約二十二萬名作戰及支援人員、十二個師和約五百門火砲；越方常見估計則為三萬至五萬名投入作戰的正規軍，另有邊防、警衛及後續部隊。邊境戰線約五百公里，但多數師的實際推進只有一至數十公里，攻擊重點集中在少數口岸、道路樞紐和山脊。傷亡資料受陣亡確認、受傷治療、失聯追補及統計時點影響，中方公開數字與越方宣稱差異很大；較可靠的概括只是雙方都有數千至數萬量級的死亡，因此不採用任何單一精確總數。
dataEn: Border exchanges had already been occurring during January 1979. Beijing issued its final diplomatic note on 16 February, the offensive began on 17 February, withdrawal was announced on 5 March, and the last Chinese troops left Vietnamese territory on 16 March, producing a campaign spanning twenty-eight calendar days. Frequently cited strength estimates summarize the Chinese commitment as approximately 220,000 combat and support personnel from twelve divisions, together with about 500 artillery pieces. Common Vietnamese estimates place the number of regular troops committed at between 30,000 and 50,000, in addition to border, guard, and follow-on formations. The border theater extended for roughly 500 kilometers, but most divisions advanced only between one and several tens of kilometers. Fighting concentrated on a limited number of crossings, road junctions, and ridges. Casualty figures vary because of differences in confirmation of deaths, treatment of wounded, recovery of the missing, and the date of each count. Chinese public figures and Vietnamese claims differ substantially, so the defensible generalization is that both sides suffered deaths numbering in the thousands to tens of thousands. No single precise total is therefore adopted.
cause: 戰爭不是由單一事件引發，而是長期邊界爭端、軍事姿態與1978年後區域變化累積而成。中越邊境若干地段一直存在界碑位置、巡邏範圍及武裝力量部署的爭議，1978至1979年間的交火又使彼此都提高戒備。1978年越南出兵柬埔寨、推翻赤柬並在北部邊境擴軍；北京擔心蘇聯武器與蘇越軍事合作會使雲南和廣西方向受包圍，同時把越軍進入邊境地帶及零星襲擾視為直接威脅。越南則認為中國在邊境大規模集兵、進行炮擊與前沿部署，自身只是在保衛受到接觸的陣地。1979年1月雙方砲戰升級，2月7日前後天保等中國邊防點遭攻擊或射擊，成為近距離衝突的導火線之一。2月16日北京發出最後照會，翌日凌晨中國軍隊展開攻勢。中方把目的限定在邊境防衛與懲罰越方邊境行動，越方則把全軍迎戰描述抵抗入侵；兩種官方敘事不同，但直接成因而確是邊境火力、陣地與部隊控制權的即時衝突。
causeEn: The war was not triggered by a single incident. It resulted from the accumulation of long-running border disputes, military postures, and regional changes after 1978. Several stretches of the Sino-Vietnamese frontier had long involved disputes over boundary-marker positions, patrol zones, and armed deployments, and fighting during 1978 and 1979 increased mutual readiness. In 1978, Vietnam entered Cambodia, overthrew the Khmer Rouge, and expanded its northern border presence. Beijing feared that Soviet weapons and the expanding Soviet-Vietnamese military relationship would encircle Yunnan and Guangxi, while also treating Vietnamese movements into the border zone and isolated attacks as direct threats. Vietnam, conversely, regarded the Chinese troop concentration, artillery exchanges, and forward deployments as offensive preparations and considered that its forces were defending positions that had been contacted. Artillery exchanges intensified in January 1979, and attacks or firing against Chinese border posts including Tianbao around 7 February became an immediate trigger for close combat. Beijing issued a final note on 16 February, and Chinese forces attacked in the following predawn hours. China defined its aims as border defense and punishment for Vietnamese border actions, while Vietnam described its nationwide response as resistance to invasion. The official narratives differed, but the immediate cause was an actual contest over border fire, positions, and control of ground in the frontier zone.
impact: 戰爭的實際影響首先出現在戰役保障與部隊運用。中國一度奪取多個邊境城鎮和交通節點，使越南後方的道路、橋梁、指揮所、彈藥庫與油料庫直接受到威脅；越南則被迫把後調師團投入高平、諒山和寶獵方向，以砲兵反擊及陣地戰消耗進攻部隊。山地作戰也暴露了進攻方後勤限制：道路越往縱深越窄，橋梁、燃料、通信、傷員後送與戰場修理越難同步，坦克前進必須依賴步兵和工兵開路。這次經驗促使中國檢討山地協同、通信及後勤指揮，並在往後years加強立體化與現代化作戰準備；越南則更重視預備隊保存、反裝甲射擊和由固定陣地轉向機動反擊。戰略上，越南在諒山方向阻止了中國繼續深入，中國仍以壓倒性砲兵火力奪取並暫時控制若干邊境要地。地區層面上，河內進一步依賴蘇聯軍援，中國加強西南邊防與對蘇越軍事格局的因應；中越交火在停火後仍多次發生，兩國直到1991年才正式恢復外交關係。
impactEn: The war's practical effects appeared first in operational support and force employment. China temporarily seized several border towns and transport nodes, placing Vietnamese roads, bridges, command posts, ammunition depots, and fuel stores directly at risk. Vietnam was compelled to commit divisions from the interior to the Cao Bằng, Lạng Sơn, and Bảo Lộc sectors, using artillery counterfire and positional combat to wear down attacking formations. Mountain operations also exposed the attacker's logistical constraints. Roads narrowed with every increment of depth, making bridges, fuel, communications, casualty evacuation, and field repair increasingly difficult to synchronize. Tanks could advance only where infantry and engineers had opened a usable route. The experience led China to examine combined operations in mountains, communications, and logistics, while reinforcing later modernization and more integrated operational preparations. Vietnam placed greater emphasis on preserving reserves, antiarmor fire, and mobile counterattacks rather than relying solely on static positions. Strategically, Vietnam prevented further Chinese penetration at Lạng Sơn, while China used its superior artillery to seize and temporarily hold several border objectives. At the regional level, Hanoi relied more heavily on Soviet military support, and China strengthened its southwestern defenses and response to the Soviet-Vietnamese military balance. Border exchanges recurred after the fighting stopped, and the two countries did not formally restore diplomatic relations until 1991.
result: 攻勢初期，中國在北線於2月18日控制高平，南線同日進入老街與寶獵，取得坦克可用的道路和數處重要高地；在諒山方向，中國部隊推進到Mộc Thạnh及城郊外圍，卻未能佔領市區，越南第四十三步兵師及其增援仍守住該方向。寶獵等地的越南守軍曾發動側擊和夜襲，一度奪回部分陣地；中國 troops則在二月下旬停止多數縱深推進，轉為鞏固已控制地區，以縮短補給線。雙方沒有達成決定性的政治交換：中國能迅速奪取孤立邊境據點，卻未建立廣泛而持續的佔領體系；越南未能阻止所有越境攻勢，但保存了諒山等關鍵城鎮，並以縱深預備隊和反擊迫使進攻停止。3月5日北京宣布撤軍後，中國部隊按作戰梯隊撤出越南，後方由擔任警戒的部隊掩護；越南軍隊在中國後撤過程中追擊並重新控制被放棄的城鎮。3月16日最後一批中國軍隊離開，雙方大致回到攻勢前的邊境部署。中國完成了暫時奪取邊境目標後再撤出的有限軍事行動，越南則阻止了對河內方向構成持續威脅的深入佔領；沒有形成永久性領土變更，也沒有隨之簽訂解決邊界的條約。
resultEn: Early in the offensive, Chinese forces controlled Cao Bằng in the northern sector on 18 February. In the south, they entered Lào Cai and Bảo Lộc the same day, gaining roads suitable for tanks and several important heights. In the direction of Lạng Sơn, Chinese troops reached Mộc Thạnh and the outer approaches to the city but did not occupy the urban center, which remained in the hands of the Vietnamese 43rd Infantry Division and its reinforcements. Vietnamese defenders around Bảo Lộc launched flank attacks and nighttime counterattacks and temporarily recovered some positions. By late February, China had ended most of its deeper advances and shifted to consolidating controlled areas so that supply routes could be shortened. The two sides reached no decisive political settlement. China could seize isolated border positions rapidly but did not establish a broad and durable occupation. Vietnam could not prevent every cross-border attack, but it preserved key towns such as Lạng Sơn and used strategic reserves and counterattacks to force the offensive to stop. After Beijing announced withdrawal on 5 March, Chinese formations departed Vietnam in operational echelons while rear units provided covering protection. Vietnamese forces followed during the withdrawal and regained cities that Chinese troops abandoned. On 16 March, the last Chinese troops departed, and both sides returned broadly to the frontier deployment that had existed before the offensive. China had carried out a limited operation that temporarily seized border objectives before withdrawing, while Vietnam had prevented a sustained occupation threatening Hà Nội. No permanent territorial alteration resulted, and no border treaty followed the fighting.
